description: A rival's market in one storefront: on Google Play the exact install count and in-app purchase price range, and the installs between two measurements once there are two; on the App Store its price, rating count, release date and whether it sells in-app purchases. Measured on request and kept for 7 days.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

name: get_rival_market
